title: How to Install a Dual-Flush Toilet (Skirted) — Mounting, Wax Seal, Tank, and Water Connection

locations.name: Probable bathroom
locations.basis: Toilet installation on tile floor; transcript implies bathroom scenario but no explicit shooting location named.

summary: This Old House demonstrates installing a skirted, dual-flush toilet, including discussion of dual-flush operation (0.9 gpf for liquids and 1.6 gpf for solids) and a concealed mounting system. The video walks through removing the old wax seal and bolts, using a manufacturer template to place mounting blocks, drilling through tile and into wood, installing mounting hardware and a wax ring, dropping the toilet into place, securing it with brass screws and chrome caps, and assembling the tank to the bowl with a gasket and bolts. It then covers connecting the water supply and refill tube, reinstalling the flush valve, turning the water back on, and placing the tank top. The transcript notes practical tips such as keeping the wax seal at room temperature for compression and using a sharp masonry bit for tile work.

sections.title: Introduction: Dual-flush features and skirted design
sections.description: The presenter introduces the dual-flush toilet, highlighting the two flush options and the skirted design that hides closet bolts.

sections.title: Prepare mounting surface: remove old hardware and plan block placement
sections.description: Notes the old wax seal and bolts are removed and a manufacturer template is used to determine where mounting blocks will go.

sections.title: Mark and drill mounting holes in tile and wood
sections.description: Demonstrates marking drill locations and drilling through tile with a masonry bit, then switching to a high-speed bit to create a pilot hole in the wood substrate.

sections.title: Install mounting blocks and prepare wax seal
sections.description: Shows installing mounting blocks and positioning the wax seal to ensure it compresses properly when tightened.

sections.title: Set toilet onto mounting blocks and secure
sections.description: Dropping the toilet into place, aligning holes with blocks, and securing with brass mounting screws; chrome caps will cover the screws.

sections.title: Connect tank to bowl and secure with bolts
sections.description: Attaches the tank to the bowl using a gasket and bolts, tightening with brass nuts and washers for a watertight seal.

sections.title: Install flush valve and finalize connections
sections.description: Reinstalls the flush valve and completes the connections between the tank and the plumbing components.

sections.title: Turn on water and finish tank top installation
sections.description: Turns the water back on and places the tank top, completing the installation.
